baseline_tag.name: phase-3-model-baseline-v0
baseline_tag.note: Pre-existing tag identifies artifact baseline and was not moved to evidence-complete commit.

experiments.hypothesis: Increasing retrieval top-k alone can recover most misses.
experiments.result: k=3 to k=5 changed model-input recall 0.667 to 0.708, average calls 1.125 to 1.25, false exposures 10 to 12
experiments.interpretation: Most failures occur before top-k because no candidate passes relevance; larger k is not the primary fix.

experiments.hypothesis: Perfect retrieval would reveal remaining classifier capability separately from retrieval.
experiments.primary_variable: oracle expected requirement replaces production retrieval
experiments.interpretation: Retrieval is a major limitation but not the only one; six of thirteen additions still became modified under oracle input.

experiments.hypothesis: Ignoring conjunction token 'and' will reduce false retrieval evidence and recover ranking precision without recall loss.
Evidence-backed vocabulary normalization will recover lexical retrieval misses without excessive false exposure.
Top-k 2 after R2 can reduce workload while retaining retrieval quality.
Explicit label boundaries and instruction/content separation reduce modified overprediction and injection failures.
Canonical presentation rules should not overwrite validated semantic labels.
Corpus-generic actor/container tokens inflate irrelevant candidates after R2.
BM25 IDF and length normalization improve ranking as project size grows without uncontrolled false exposure.
experiments.configuration: binary-tf BM25 k1=1.2 b=0.75 title+description token union; cap=3; coarse threshold 0.05-0.25
experiments.resource_use: CPU-only in-memory scorer; no model weights
experiments.notes: Ranking reached 36/40 new links at top 3, but preregistered selection calibration did not produce a safe recall/exposure point.

experiments.hypothesis: A small semantic encoder will recover low-overlap positives without material false exposure at a fixed cosine threshold.
experiments.configuration: all-MiniLM-L6-v2@c9745ed1d9f207416be6d2e6f8de32d1f16199bf; masked mean pooling; L2; cosine >=0.45; cap=3
experiments.resource_use: CPU-only; 88 MB weight cache; observed process peak 807536 KiB and warm 86-text batch 5.38 s
experiments.notes: Lower false exposure than R5 on both development sets, but neither overall nor all size gates passed; weights are not tracked.

experiments.hypothesis: A coarse lexical-semantic blend may retain semantic recall while reducing irrelevant exposure.
experiments.primary_variable: hybrid score weight and preregistered threshold grid
experiments.resource_use: CPU score fusion over cached development traces
experiments.notes: No stable recall/false-exposure point across both corpora; high-recall settings overexpose candidates.

experiments.hypothesis: Transparent clause decomposition recovers multi-intent targets diluted by whole-message embeddings.
experiments.configuration: whole message plus comma/semicolon/and clauses >=3 words; max cosine; threshold 0.45; cap=3
experiments.resource_use: CPU-only same encoder; more query embeddings
experiments.notes: Two new-set links gained over S1, but one extra false exposure; one fewer link and four extra false exposures on older development.

experiments.hypothesis: Frozen R6-S1 generalizes to independently reviewed small, medium, and large projects under unchanged retrieval gates.
experiments.primary_variable: blind corpus only; no candidate changes
experiments.resource_use: CPU-only pinned 88 MB encoder; observed final 86-text batch 5.04 s, scoring 12.76 ms total excluding embeddings
experiments.notes: R6 22/36 overall; small 9/10, medium 7/14, large 6/12; fails 90% overall and 85% medium/large gates. No 7B inference, V3, promotion, or retraining.

experiments.hypothesis: Separating ranking, selection, project-size competition and candidate cost will identify whether a new retrieval architecture is warranted.
experiments.primary_variable: architecture family and controlled project size; frozen historical controls
experiments.decision_rule: No R7 absent substantial stable cross-size recall gain at defensible cost; no closed-data tuning.
